As a developer, I want to implement a new authentication module so that users can securely log in to the system.

AC1: The login form validates email format using RFC 5322.
AC2: Password is hashed using bcrypt with salt rounds >= 12.
AC3: Failed login attempts are logged to audit trail.
AC4: After 5 failed attempts, account is locked for 15 minutes.

This is a straightforward feature request with clear acceptance criteria and no suspicious patterns.
